SRC-306:R001.text: SAIPEN closure must enforce typed mandatory acceptance receipts: a ticket whose acceptance contract requires per-invariant, per-platform proof cannot reach DONE while a required receipt is absent. Record the outcome as Windows PASS / Linux NOT_RUN / real-media NOT_RUN rather than collapsing multi-platform acceptance into one green suite.

SRC-306:R002.text: SAIPEN must enforce ticket authority uniformly across every repository-mutating route (ticket add, claim, transition, closure), not only through continue/goal entry: a RECONCILE_REAUTH_REQUIRED or WAIT_OPERATOR state keeps read-only diagnosis available but refuses consequential mutations until a real operator decision.

SRC-306:R003.text: A phase shortcut must not overwrite a tripped bounded safety-valve WAIT. State transition and brake normalization are one atomic transaction; a regression proves that at the ticket cap the phase changes only as permitted while the canonical WAIT survives, and continue still refuses without witnessed operator reauthorization.
